title: Cloudflare tunnel in token mode — local config not applied
summary: Attempted to apply /api/* ingress rule via local config.yml. Tunnel is running in token mode (managed via Cloudflare dashboard), which ignores local config file. Changes must be pushed to dashboard instead.
root_cause: cloudflared process runs 'tunnel run --token <...>' which reads ingress rules from Cloudflare API, not from local config.yml
recovery_path: Option 1: Update Cloudflare dashboard directly to add ^/api/* ingress rule → localhost:4000
Option 2: Export tunnel credentials locally and switch service to config-file mode
next_steps: Escalate to dev-mcp-server — requires Cloudflare dashboard access or tunnel credential export
